predictions.evidence: Checked for pmeq: wrong options on plus, minus, equals, reading aloud, and fair 5=2+3.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked for pmeq: why() splits take/box/put/line, right/eqtake, and taway/abox/hide tags.

no_filler.evidence: Checked for pmeq: no journey/delve filler; each line teaches a sign meaning or the equals myth.

mobile.evidence: Checked for pmeq: name/read/truth buttons stay tappable at 390px in the young shell.
